body:
FOUC INVESTIGATION COMPLETE. Astro 6.1.0, static output, Vercel adapter, Tailwind v4 via @tailwindcss/vite plugin.

TL;DR: No bug in CSS loading itself — single shared stylesheet, correctly placed in <head>, same hash on all pages. The white flash comes from the interaction of Astro's ClientRouter (View Transitions) with the default "animate" swap behavior. During view transitions Astro shows a fallback/blank state before swapping DOM; dark background is applied by CSS that only becomes active after the swap finishes, and there is NO inline dark background in the <html> element to cover the gap. The browser paints white during the transition gap. This is a known Astro View Transitions FOUC pattern, documented at astro.build/docs/guides/view-transitions/#style.

KEY FINDINGS:
1. View transitions ARE active. `ClientRouter` imported at src/layouts/Layout.astro:4, rendered in <head> at line 78. All 8 pages use `<Navigation client:load transition:persist />` (index.astro:19, about/index.astro:56, blog/index.astro:41, blog/[slug].astro:196, blog/search.astro:22, blog/tag/[tag].astro:33, cv/index.astro:152, 404.astro:11). Built output has `<meta name="astro-view-transitions-enabled" content="true">` + fallback=animate in dist head.

2. CSS loading is CORRECT. global.css imported in Layout.astro:5 (frontmatter, not <head> — but Astro hoists it correctly). Built output: all pages link single `/ _astro/Layout.BcstWWkA.css` in <head> (offset ~12063/14128, i.e. near end of head). Same hash on every route → no per-page CSS mismatch on nav. No `inlineStylesheets` or `assetsInlineLimit` config in astro.config.mjs → CSS is external file, NOT inlined (Astro default for build).

3. ROOT CAUSE — two compounding factors:
   (a) View transition gap. ClientRouter's default swap ("animate" fallback, `astro-view-transitions-fallback content="animate"` in dist) runs document.startViewTransition(); browser screenshots old page, then during transition the new document is being fetched/parsed and the old page's background is removed while new CSS applies only after swap. In the gap, the default white UA background shows. Analyzed dist ClientRouter JS (function ve preloads stylesheets, be re-executes scripts, ae swaps persisted nodes — swap happens after fetch+preload, and CSS is fetched only on navigation, not preloaded ahead of time).
   (b) No inline background fallback. `html` and `body` dark background lives ONLY in external CSS (global.css lines ~26-38: `html { background-color: var(--color-bg) }`). Layout.astro:47 `<html lang="en">` has no inline style/class. During any pre-CSS paint (initial load and transition gap), browser paints white. Astro's docs explicitly recommend a background color on the `<html>` element for this reason.

4. Fonts render-blocking. Google Fonts stylesheet (Layout.astro:69) has no preload; JetBrains Mono flash risk on headings. Minor vs background flash.

5. No custom inline-scripts before CSS in head; Vercel Analytics inline script runs after ClientRouter but doesn't delay CSS. Navigation.tsx is client:load React (framer-motion) — animates header on mount but does NOT cause flash; it re-hydrates each page, and with transition:persist the old node is reused across swaps.

FIX RECOMMENDATIONS (for coordinator/builder):
1. Add inline dark background on `<html>` in Layout.astro:47: `<html lang="en" style="background-color:#0a0a0a">` — cheapest, most reliable fix; also kills flash on slow first load.
2. Alternatively enable CSS inlining: astro.config.mjs `build.inlineStylesheets: 'always'` (or 'auto' — 53KB single CSS, 'always' inlines into head; may not be needed if fix 1 done).
3. Optional: `<link rel="preload" as="style">` for Layout.BcstWWkA.css before the stylesheet link, or set `build.inlineStylesheets`. Optional: preload Google Fonts CSS.
4. Note for tester: verify after fix with dev server + network throttle (slow 3G), navigate / → /about/ → /blog/, watch for white flash between pages.
